meta.name: Chupkotha 2 720p
meta.description: Journalist Shivangi gets trapped in many mysteries in her personal and professional life. Is everything a coincidence, or is there an uncanny connection?

videos.title: Se Ashche
videos.overview: Shivangi is in charge of covering a murder case for the news channel she works for. She soon discovers that the victim is someone close to her.

videos.title: Serial Killer
videos.overview: Once again, someone Shivangi knows closely gets murdered. The method of killing is the same as that of the previous murder. Is this the work of a serial killer?

videos.title: Ondhokaare Ambassador
videos.overview: At a time when Shivangi is already distressed by two murders, she gets the news of another death. This time, the incident has taken place in her own house.

videos.title: Dhandar Cheyeo Jotil
videos.overview: Shivangi takes a look at the CCTV footage and sees something that confuses and shocks her. Everything seems more puzzling when she reaches the Police Station.

videos.title: Maa Aar Ashbe Na
videos.overview: As the mystery unfolds before Shivangi, she is forced to remember the scariest experience of her life. Will she be able to protect everyone from evil?
